text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_type
Description
This command returns the alert type.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_type
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert type: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_type]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
